real: geoBoundaries (gbOpen, OSM): boundaries of the 26 provinces
Natural Earth 10m: major rivers, roads, cities
AWS Terrain Tiles (Terrarium; SRTM/NASADEM): elevation, slope, curvature
Drainage network and discharge derived from the DEM (priority-flood + D8, Budyko runoff)
NOAA GHCN-Daily: monthly rainfall and temperature normals from 22 stations
NASA POWER (MERRA-2, 2001-2025 climatology): 102 points on a 1.5° grid
Water Point Data Exchange (WPdx-Basic): 7956 DRC water points (validation)
BGS Africa Groundwater Atlas (MacDonald et al. 2012): aquifer productivity, 5 km (model v2)
GLOBGM v1.0 (Verkaik et al. 2024, via Google Earth Engine): steady-state water-table depth, 1 km (model v2)
CHIRPS (via Google Earth Engine): 1991-2020 monthly rainfall climatology, ~5 km (model v2)
SoilGrids 2.0 (ISRIC, via Google Earth Engine): 0-30 cm sand and clay, 250 m (model v2)
WorldPop 2020 (via Google Earth Engine): population per cell, 100 m (validation)
JRC Global Surface Water v1.4 (via Google Earth Engine): permanent surface water share
synthetic: Hydrogeological domains, lithological favourability and borehole yield (approx. Africa Groundwater Atlas / MacDonald 2012)
Soil permeability by domain (instead of SoilGrids)
NDVI estimated from rainfall (instead of Sentinel/MODIS)
β coefficients of the WTD regression (no calibration wells)
Mean discharge of major rivers: approximate literature values
Population index by city gravity model (instead of WorldPop)
